title: 🌸說到 看完☄️的live後自己也更想辦第二場了 想到過去一路走來的辛苦 經歷了好多事情 以前常被人拿來比較 常常煩惱著如何才能讓大家來看自己 回憶並不總是好的 但是有經歷過那些才…
context:
🌸說到

看完☄️的live後自己也更想辦第二場了
想到過去一路走來的辛苦
經歷了好多事情
以前常被人拿來比較
常常煩惱著如何才能讓大家來看自己
回憶並不總是好的
但是有經歷過那些才有現在的🌸

覺得☄️真的很厲害
雖然覺得☄️很厲害
但不是要成為☄️
而是想變成像☄️那樣活躍的人
🌸要做的事和☄️是不一樣的
若是做一樣的事🌸是不會贏☄️的
🌸沒辦法像☄️那樣帥氣的在舞台上唱歌
🌸要走的是自己的步調和賽道
🌸無法成為☄️
☄️也沒法成為🌸
但是真的從☄️那學到很多
雖然兩人用的方法不同
但到達那個大舞台的目標是一樣的

🌸 said that after watching ☄️’s live, she felt even more motivated to hold a second one herself.

Thinking back on the hardships she’s faced along the way,
so many things have happened.
In the past, she was often compared to others,
constantly worrying about how to get people to come watch her.
Not all memories are good ones,
but it’s because of those experiences that 🌸 is who she is today.

🌸thinks☄️ is truly incredible.
Even though she admires ☄️,
it’s not about becoming ☄️—
it’s about becoming someone as active and successful as ☄️.

What 🌸 wants to do is different from what ☄️ is doing.
If she was to do the same thing, she would never be able to surpass ☄️.

🌸 can’t stand on stage and sing as cool as ☄️.
She needs to walk her own path and race in her own lane.

🌸 can’t become ☄️,
and ☄️ can’t become 🌸 either.
But she has truly learned so much from ☄️.

Even though they take different approaches,
their goal of reaching that grand stage is the same.
🌸從遠方看到了☄️
便邊唱著BBDB邊跑向☄️
（🌸見到☄️先打一下）

☄️：🍌！

🌸：是🍌☄️啊！🌸在這世上最喜歡的就是🍌☄️了⋯因為這個時候最乖了⋯對吧⋯彗醬？
彗醬！Bluerose！（🌸丟花在☄️腳邊。）
彗醬！⋯彗醬！過來幫忙！
（☄️點頭。）

此時不遠處傳來🍙的笑聲。

🍙：上面好像有誰在？
🌸：🍙！
🍙：呀吼！☄️也在呀？
🌸：Bluerose。

（三人開始邊唱邊跳Bluerose。正確來說，因為☄️今天是無線電靜默模式所以只有🌸🍙兩人唱。)

🍙：☄️live 辛苦了，真的超神的。
🌸：真的很棒，Sui她哭了，哭慘了呢對吧。
🍙：我有看到！，沒有放棄音樂真的太好了呢。

（此時☄️開始彎著腰向後退。）

🍙：啊在害羞了。
🌸：害羞了啊。

🌸 saw ☄️ from afar
and ran towards ☄️ while singing BBDB.
(🌸 gave ☄️ a little hit upon meeting.)

☄️: 🍌!

🌸: It’s 🍌☄️! The one I love most in this world is 🍌☄️…
Because at times like this, you’re the most well-behaved… Right, Suichan?
Suichan! Blue Rose!
(🌸 threw a flower at ☄️’s feet.)
Suichan! …Suichan! Come help!
(☄️ nodded.)

At that moment, laughter could be heard from a short distance away.

🍙: Looks like someone’s up there?
🌸: 🍙!
🍙: Yahhoo! ☄️ is here too?
🌸: Bluerose.

(The three of them started singing and dancing to Bluerose.
Technically, since ☄️ was in radio silence mode today, only 🌸 and 🍙 were singing.)

🍙: ☄️, great job on the live! It was absolutely amazing.
🌸: It really was. Sui cried—cried a lot, right?
🍙: I saw! It’s really great that she never gave up on music.

(At that moment, ☄️ started stepping back while bending over.)

🍙: Ah, getting shy now.
🌸: Getting shy, huh?
🌸：看了☄️的武道館演唱會。真的太棒了。
有發生好多事情，但是因為太感動了所以很多都忘了。
☄️會哭那麼慘真的很少見呢。
最後的那個留言想了很久
但不知該怎麼寫
不知怎麼用言語表達
所以就寫了一句話
(但是是最重要的一句）
後來才發現自己寫的很少
（這個我也是覺得如此⋯有時太親近的人反而會寫不出來）
☄️說過想做的事都達成了

🌸沒有去看別人的Live的習慣
但是☄️會去
之前☄️就有帶🌸去看別的Live
然後看到別人有發彩帶的作法
🌸便決定自己的Live也要用

🌸: I watched ☄️’s Budokan concert. It was truly amazing.

So many things happened, but I was so moved that I forgot a lot of them.

It’s really rare to see ☄️ cry that much.

I thought for a long time about what message to leave at the end,
but I didn’t know how to put it into words,
so I just wrote one sentence—
(but the most important one).

Later, I realized that I had written very little.
(I feel the same way… Sometimes, when someone is too close to you, it’s even harder to find the right words.)

☄️ said that everything she wanted to achieve has been accomplished.

🌸 doesn’t have the habit of going to other people’s live concerts,
but ☄️ does.

Previously, ☄️ even took 🌸 to see another concert.

Seeing how they gave out streamers,
🌸 decided to use that idea for her own live
 concert as well.
